page.description: Enter the alcove dimensions, pick columns, fittings and materials, see the wardrobe and a price estimate at once, then generate a PDF quote.
page.h1: Ateljé Plakar — wardrobe configurator with a PDF quote
body: Enter the alcove dimensions, pick the columns, fittings and materials, and see the wardrobe straight away along with a price estimate. The client does not wait for someone to get back to them.
At the end it generates a PDF quote, ready to send — so the joiner does not write the specification out by hand.

A PDF quote for the client in one click
